hedge: Evidence mapping, not a certification claim. Control IDs name where Matrix Scroll record types can supply evidence; they do not assert that a deployment is 800-53 assessed or authorized.

mappings.title: Event Logging
mappings.evidence_note: Signed envelopes and ledger records document which events were recorded.

mappings.title: Content of Audit Records
mappings.evidence_note: Actor, tool, schema, and payload fields supply structured audit content.

mappings.title: Time Stamps
mappings.evidence_note: Optional RFC 3161-shaped tokens and epoch checkpoints bind time metadata.

mappings.title: Protection of Audit Information
mappings.evidence_note: Ed25519 (and optional PQC overlay) signatures protect record integrity.

mappings.title: Non-repudiation
mappings.evidence_note: Device-bound keys and optional human mandate chains support non-repudiation evidence.

mappings.title: Audit Record Generation
mappings.evidence_note: CLI, MCP tools, and optional proxy intercept generate signed records.

mappings.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
mappings.evidence_note: Trusted-key policy, PQC identity store, and ML-KEM primitives for sealed packs.

mappings.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
mappings.evidence_note: Offline verify and sealed packs support integrity checking of signed artifacts.

mappings.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Minimize Personally Identifiable Information
mappings.evidence_note: Schemas encourage scope-bounded payloads; operators still control what enters a record.
